stem: Ms. Versini applied for a car loan from a bank. Which statement best describes the importance of Ms. Versini's credit report to the bank?

options.label: F
options.text: The report shows the likelihood that Ms. Versini will pay back the entire loan on time.

options.label: G
options.text: The report shows the highest level of education that Ms. Versini has reached.

options.label: H
options.text: The bank gives higher interest rates to people with higher credit scores.

options.label: J
options.text: The bank gives partial loans to people with strong credit.
